# iDempiere Documentation

> Documentation for iDempiere, an open source ERP: installation, OSGi plug-in development, 2Pack, functional guides and release notes.

This file contains links to documentation sections following the llmstxt.org standard.

## Table of Contents

- [Ditch XML: Declare Service Annotations and Simplify Plug-in Development](https://docs.idempiere.org/docs/basic-development/plugin-development/annotations-instead-xml.md): Learn how to use OSGi Declarative Service annotations to simplify plug-in development in iDempiere.
- [Developing Plug-ins Without Affecting the Core](https://docs.idempiere.org/docs/basic-development/plugin-development/developing-plugins.md): How to develop iDempiere plug-ins independently from the core codebase
- [Distributing and Installing Plug-ins in iDempiere](https://docs.idempiere.org/docs/basic-development/plugin-development/distributing-plugins.md): Guide to distribute and install plug-ins in iDempiere.
- [Contributing an Extension to the Registry](https://docs.idempiere.org/docs/basic-development/plugin-development/extension-registry-contributing.md): How to publish a plug-in to the official iDempiere Extension Registry so any iDempiere 14+ instance can find and install it.
- [Testing an Extension Locally](https://docs.idempiere.org/docs/basic-development/plugin-development/extension-registry-local-testing.md): Point an iDempiere instance at a local file: extension provider to test the full install, update, disable, and uninstall cycle before publishing.
- [Extension Registry Worked Example](https://docs.idempiere.org/docs/basic-development/plugin-development/extension-registry-worked-example.md): A real plug-in submitted to the Extension Registry from start to finish, including the mistakes and open items it surfaced.
- [Developing Plug-in Callouts](https://docs.idempiere.org/docs/basic-development/plugin-development/plugin-callouts.md): Learn how to implement column callouts in iDempiere plug-ins using modern best practices.
- [Custom Credit Management in Plug-ins](https://docs.idempiere.org/docs/basic-development/plugin-development/plugin-credit-manager-factory.md): Learn how to customize iDempiere's credit management behavior using ICreditManagerFactory and ICreditManager.
- [Developing Dashboard Panel Fragments](https://docs.idempiere.org/docs/basic-development/plugin-development/plugin-dashboard-panels.md): Learn how to create custom Dashboard Panels for the iDempiere WebUI using OSGi fragment projects.
- [OSGi and MANIFEST.MF Background](https://docs.idempiere.org/docs/basic-development/plugin-development/plugin-development-background.md): Background reference on MANIFEST.MF, plugin.xml, OSGi concepts, and key iDempiere plug-in projects.
- [Using IDocFactory for Custom Accounting](https://docs.idempiere.org/docs/basic-development/plugin-development/plugin-doc-factory.md): Learn how to implement custom accounting for core documents in iDempiere using the IDocFactory service.
- [IEditorFactory and IDisplayTypeFactory](https://docs.idempiere.org/docs/basic-development/plugin-development/plugin-editor-factory.md): Learn how to create custom field editors and display types for the iDempiere WebUI using IEditorFactory and IDisplayTypeFactory.
- [Developing Plug-in Event Handlers](https://docs.idempiere.org/docs/basic-development/plugin-development/plugin-eventhandler.md): Learn how to implement event handlers in iDempiere plug-ins to intercept and respond to model events.
- [Developing Plug-in Forms](https://docs.idempiere.org/docs/basic-development/plugin-development/plugin-forms.md): Learn how to create custom forms in iDempiere plug-ins using the IFormFactory service.
- [Building iDempiere Plug-ins with Maven](https://docs.idempiere.org/docs/basic-development/plugin-development/plugin-maven-build.md): Learn how to build iDempiere plug-ins using Maven (Tycho), the build system adopted from iDempiere 6.1 onward.
- [Using IModelFactory in Plug-ins](https://docs.idempiere.org/docs/basic-development/plugin-development/plugin-modelfactory.md): Learn how to use the IModelFactory service to provide custom model classes in your iDempiere plug-in
- [Developing Plug-in Model Validators](https://docs.idempiere.org/docs/basic-development/plugin-development/plugin-modelvalidator.md): Learn how to create model validators in iDempiere plug-ins to add custom validation logic.
- [Developing Plug-in Processes](https://docs.idempiere.org/docs/basic-development/plugin-development/plugin-process.md): Learn how to create and manage custom processes in iDempiere plug-ins.
- [Custom Product Pricing in Plug-ins](https://docs.idempiere.org/docs/basic-development/plugin-development/plugin-product-pricing.md): Learn how to extend product pricing in iDempiere using IProductPricingFactory.
- [Running Plug-ins Locally in iDempiere](https://docs.idempiere.org/docs/basic-development/plugin-development/plugin-running-locally.md): Guide to configure and run plug-ins locally in iDempiere.
- [Server Push in Plug-ins](https://docs.idempiere.org/docs/basic-development/plugin-development/plugin-server-push.md): Learn how to use ServerPushTemplate, IServerPushCallback, and ITopicSubscriber to broadcast real-time messages between iDempiere WebUI sessions.
- [Using ITaxProviderFactory in Plug-ins](https://docs.idempiere.org/docs/basic-development/plugin-development/plugin-tax-provider-factory.md): Learn how to implement a custom tax provider in iDempiere using the ITaxProviderFactory service.
- [Developing WebUI Themes](https://docs.idempiere.org/docs/basic-development/plugin-development/plugin-webui-themes.md): Learn how to create custom WebUI themes for iDempiere using OSGi fragment projects.
- [Migration notes - iDempiere 14 (technical)](https://docs.idempiere.org/docs/migration-notes/v14/technical-notes.md): Technical migration notes for upgrading to iDempiere 14.
- [Migration notes - iDempiere 13 (functional)](https://docs.idempiere.org/docs/migration-notes/v13/functional-notes.md): Functional migration notes for upgrading to iDempiere 13.
- [Removed deprecated APIs - iDempiere 13](https://docs.idempiere.org/docs/migration-notes/v13/removed-deprecated-apis.md): Reference list of classes and methods removed in iDempiere 13 that had been deprecated for more than two major releases.
- [Migration notes - iDempiere 13 (technical)](https://docs.idempiere.org/docs/migration-notes/v13/technical-notes.md): Technical migration notes for upgrading to iDempiere 13.

- [Field Event Rules](https://docs.idempiere.org/docs/available-plugins/field-event-rules.md): Field Event Rules let you define "when this field changes, do that" logic in the Application Dictionary without writing Java code.
- [SQL Query Enhanced](https://docs.idempiere.org/docs/available-plugins/sql-query-enhanced.md): SQL Query Enhanced replaces the standard SQL Query form with a code editor, a statement history and tools to copy and export the results.

- [Add Fixed Price Discount Support to Discount Schema](https://docs.idempiere.org/docs/new-features/v10/add-fixed-price-discount-support-to-discount-schema.md): Enhance discount schema to support the setting of fixed unit price for each discount break point.

- [Synchronize Print Format Items](https://docs.idempiere.org/docs/new-features/v10/synchronize-print-format-items.md): Especially in SaaS environnment, it is time consuming to add some columns in Report Views and make them available in reports.
- [Tabular Report Re-Run Enhancements](https://docs.idempiere.org/docs/new-features/v10/tabular-report-re-run-enhancements.md): Until now, tabular reports are opened in new tab - as result opening many tabs.
- [Tenant Time Zone for Cron Scheduler](https://docs.idempiere.org/docs/new-features/v10/tenant-time-zone-for-cron-scheduler.md): Add option to support the scheduling of cron pattern scheduler with tenant time zone instead of server time zone.
- [Wizard for Chosen Multiple Selection List editor](https://docs.idempiere.org/docs/new-features/v10/wizard-for-chosen-multiple-selection-list-editor.md): Selecting items from a multiple selection list field can be time consuming, especially if you want to order it properly.
- [Workflow EMail Notification Enhancements](https://docs.idempiere.org/docs/new-features/v10/workflow-email-notification-enhancements.md): Make attachment of PDF document to Workflow EMail Notification optional.
- [Add Java Options Field To Setup](https://docs.idempiere.org/docs/new-features/v11/add-java-options-field-to-setup.md): Added a new field to the iDempiere server setup dialog, Java Options.
- [Allow to Specify Print Format for Dashboard Content Report](https://docs.idempiere.org/docs/new-features/v11/allow-to-specify-print-format-for-dashboard-content-report.md): Allow to Specify Print Format for Dashboard Content Report: a New Feature in iDempiere 11.
- [Constraint Type for RecordID and UU](https://docs.idempiere.org/docs/new-features/v11/constraint-type-for-recordid-and-uu.md): The purpose of this improvement is to avoid storing IDs of deleted records in the RecordID column.
- [Credit Management as Factory](https://docs.idempiere.org/docs/new-features/v11/credit-management-as-factory.md): Credit Management as Factory: a New Feature in iDempiere 11.
- [Delete Trace Logs](https://docs.idempiere.org/docs/new-features/v11/delete-trace-logs.md): The purpose of this improvement is to delete old trace logs periodically that generated daily.
- [Disable OSGi Event Handler](https://docs.idempiere.org/docs/new-features/v11/disable-osgi-event-handler.md): Disable OSGi Event Handler: a New Feature in iDempiere 11.

- [Record Info Copy To Clipboard Buttons](https://docs.idempiere.org/docs/new-features/v9/record-info-copy-to-clipboard-buttons.md): Record Info Copy To Clipboard Buttons: a New Feature in iDempiere 9.
- [Replace Create From Form With Info Window Form](https://docs.idempiere.org/docs/new-features/v9/replace-create-from-form-with-info-window-form.md): Use Info Window and Process to replace existing Create From custom form.
- [Reset Accounting Documents also without Postings](https://docs.idempiere.org/docs/new-features/v9/reset-accounting-documents-also-without-postings.md): Reset Accounting Documents also without Postings: a New Feature in iDempiere 9.
- [Reverse Prepared Payment Process](https://docs.idempiere.org/docs/new-features/v9/reverse-prepared-payment-process.md): This process was implemented to be able to fix a processed Payment Selection record without the need to hack DB.
- [Save Document to Attachment](https://docs.idempiere.org/docs/new-features/v9/save-document-to-attachment.md): Save Document to Attachment: a New Feature in iDempiere 9.
- [Shipment On Availability When Products Available](https://docs.idempiere.org/docs/new-features/v9/shipment-on-availability-when-products-available.md): Shipment On Availability When Products Available: a New Feature in iDempiere 9.
- [Specify Tenant on Login](https://docs.idempiere.org/docs/new-features/v9/specify-tenant-on-login.md): Traditionally the login flow of iDempiere has allowed the user to enter username and password and select the tenant to login in a second page.
- [SQL Workflow Condition](https://docs.idempiere.org/docs/new-features/v9/sql-workflow-condition.md): SQL Workflow Condition: a New Feature in iDempiere 9.
- [Storage Reservation Log](https://docs.idempiere.org/docs/new-features/v9/storage-reservation-log.md): Storage Reservation Log: a New Feature in iDempiere 9.
- [Tenant Administrator Roles](https://docs.idempiere.org/docs/new-features/v9/tenant-administrator-roles.md): Tenant Administrator Roles: a New Feature in iDempiere 9.
- [Use iDempiere Display/Reference Type In Jasper Report](https://docs.idempiere.org/docs/new-features/v9/use-idempiere-displayreference-type-in-jasper-report.md): Allow the use of iDempiere's Display/Reference Type based rendering of data in Jasper Report.
- [Vendor Lead](https://docs.idempiere.org/docs/new-features/v9/vendor-lead.md): Idea is to use Lead to manage both Sales and Purchases sides.
- [Virtual Column Lazy Loading](https://docs.idempiere.org/docs/new-features/v9/virtual-column-lazy-loading.md): Virtual columns were loaded among the rest of the regular columns when instantiating a model class.
- [Warehouse on Inventory Move to filter Locators](https://docs.idempiere.org/docs/new-features/v9/warehouse-on-inventory-move-to-filter-locators.md): Before this enhancement, Inventory move has no restriction on warehouse.
- [Wizard Chosen Multiple Selection List Editor](https://docs.idempiere.org/docs/new-features/v9/wizard-chosen-multiple-selection-list-editor.md): Wizard Chosen Multiple Selection List Editor: a New Feature in iDempiere 9.
